Español Measles (Rubeola) About Measles is a highly contagious virus. Two doses of the MMR vaccine provide the best protection. May 29, 2024 Measles Cases and Outbreaks Find the latest numbers of confirmed U.S. measles cases. CDC updates this page weekly. May 16, 2025 Symptoms and Complications First signs of measles are fever, cough, & runny nose 7–14 days after infection. Plan for Travel Prepare for international travel with the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine. Vaccination Learn about measles vaccine basics, who should get it, when to get it, and why it's important. Measles Resources Download, print, and share free measles resources. For Professionals Stay Alert for Measles Cases Learn what to do if you suspect your patient has measles or was exposed to measles. Apr. 8, 2025 Clinical Overview Learn about clinical diagnosing and treating measles cases. July 15, 2024 For Health Departments Get key measles resources including case definitions and outbreak and response procedures. Be Ready for Measles Toolkit Use this toolkit to help you communicate, prepare, and respond to measles cases and outbreaks. Lab Testing Detection of measles RNA by RT-PCR can provide laboratory confirmation of infection. Vaccine Recommendations Find routine MMR information, evidence of immunity, other considerations for measles vaccine. Back to Top Measles (Rubeola) Measles is one of the most contagious diseases and can be dangerous in babies and young children. The best protection against measles is the MMR vaccine.
